item.title: He died in a hot house. Why is his death record missing that detail?
item.description: Adam Willson's case illustrates how Arizona's heat death statistics may overlook many victims each year.

item.title: Morning news brief
item.description: U.S. strikes on Iran continue for a second day, Trump addresses gas prices ahead of midterms, and Sen. Ed Markey wins Massachusetts primary.

item.title: Israel denies entry to U.S. citizens over criticism and Palestinian ties, lawyers report
item.description: Travelers from the U.S. and other countries are being refused entry to Israel after questioning about their connections to Palestinians and planned visits to occupied areas.

item.title: Tariffs' impact on midterms uncertain in Michigan border town
item.description: The U.S.-Canada trade dispute carries economic and political weight in Michigan, where Canada is the top trade partner.
